## check if column and row names in membership and Jaccard matrices match!
### RNAseq
```{r check if column and row names in membership and Jaccard matrices match!}
library(readr)
library(here)

dirs <- c(
  here("data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures"),
  here("data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity")
)

directions <- c("up", "dn")

results <- list()

for (dir in dirs) {
  for (direction in directions) {

    # membership
    membership <- read_tsv(
      file.path(dir, paste0(direction, "_membership_mat.tsv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    # Jaccard
    jaccard <- read_tsv(
      file.path(dir, paste0(direction, "_jaccard_mat.tsv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )

    # signature names
    membership_names <- names(membership)[-1]  # remove GeneID
    jaccard_col_names <- names(jaccard)[-1]    # remove signature
    jaccard_row_names <- jaccard[[1]]

    # check
    results[[paste(basename(dir), direction, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      directory = basename(dir),
      direction = direction,
      membership_vs_jaccard_cols =
        identical(membership_names, jaccard_col_names),
      membership_vs_jaccard_rows =
        identical(membership_names, jaccard_row_names),
      same_signature_set =
        setequal(membership_names, jaccard_col_names)
    )
  }
}

do.call(rbind, results)
```

## check if the rerun for sensitivity analysis produces the same aggregated signatures
```{r check if the rerun for sensitivity analysis produces the same aggregated signatures}
library(here)
library(readr)

comparisons <- list(
  microarray_dn = c(
    "data/signatures/microarray/aggregated_signatures/dn_aggregated_signature.tsv",
    "data/signatures/microarray/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity/dn_aggregated_signature_0.9.tsv"
  ),
  microarray_up = c(
    "data/signatures/microarray/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity/up_aggregated_signature_0.9.tsv",
    "data/signatures/microarray/aggregated_signatures/up_aggregated_signature.tsv"
  ),
  RNAseq_dn = c(
    "data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity/dn_aggregated_signature_0.9.tsv",
    "data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures/dn_aggregated_signature.tsv"
  ),
  RNAseq_up = c(
    "data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity/up_aggregated_signature_0.9.tsv",
    "data/signatures/RNAseq/aggregated_signatures/up_aggregated_signature.tsv"
  )
)

results <- lapply(names(comparisons), function(label) {
  paths <- comparisons[[label]]

  old_mem <- read_tsv(here(paths[1]), show_col_types = FALSE)
  new_mem <- read_tsv(here(paths[2]), show_col_types = FALSE)

  gene_id_equal <- old_mem$GeneID == new_mem$GeneID

  result <- list(
    comparison = label,
    all_equal = all.equal(old_mem, new_mem),
    gene_ids_identical = identical(old_mem$GeneID, new_mem$GeneID),
    differing_gene_id_rows = which(is.na(gene_id_equal) | !gene_id_equal)
  )

  print(result)
  result
})

names(results) <- names(comparisons)
```
